evidence_quotes: het besluit gebreken kent met betrekking tot de toetsing aan het geurbeleid, de BBT voor afvalwater en de MER-beoordeling.
rationale: This Dutch administrative decision reviews an environmental permit (omgevingsvergunning) for a manure processing facility and upholds the appeals in substantive part because the permit failed to properly assess Best Available Techniques for wastewater (de BBT voor afvalwater), alongside odour policy, EIA screening, and nature-permit assessment. Because industrial/facility wastewater treatment and effluent standards (BBT voor afvalwater) form an explicit substantive ground of judicial annulment rather than an incidental mention or a non-water Meststoffenwet quota dispute, both labels are coded WATER under environmental_protection, with no household connection or informal-settlement issue.
